role: Independent calibration; no Planck dark-matter density used here
bbn_assumptions: D+3nu, Neff=3.045, standard BBN, no CMB baryon prior
bbn_source: Mossa et al., Nature 587, 210-213 (2020), doi:10.1038/s41586-020-2878-4, main result and Table 1 D+3nu with LUNA
mass_convention_note: Approximate late baryonic rest mass per baryon; 1% allowance covers H/He binding and electron bookkeeping. Used as an explicit convention, not a new measured constant. The ratio omega_hidden/omega_b avoids entropy-temperature conversion uncertainty.
